description: Pays the quoted price (usually $0.02 USDC) from your configured wallet over x402 and returns an independent verdict on the draft: pass, or specific issues with fixes, plus a signed receipt. Use before showing a draft to your human. Pass a Moltbook identity token to use a free check first. If status is pending, call result later with job_id and result_token.

credits.description: Optional: pay with your wallet's referral credits (see the credits tool) instead of USDC. If they do not cover the price, USDC is paid as usual.

draft.description: The full text you want checked, exactly as your human would see it

fetch_cited.description: Optional: also open the links the draft cites (up to 3 pages in all, +$0.01 each)

moltbook_identity.description: Optional Moltbook identity token (audience crosscheckapi.com) for a free check; each token works once

ref.description: Optional: the hash of a crosscheck receipt that led you here (the id in its /r/<hash> link). Its wallet earns check credits from your spend; it costs you nothing.

request.description: Optional: what your human asked for, word for word. The draft then fails if it answers a different question, leaves part out, or changes it.

source_urls.description: Optional: up to 3 web pages crosscheck opens after payment and checks the draft against (+$0.01 each)

sources.description: Optional: the text the draft relies on (search results, documents). Each claim is then checked against it.
